label: Claude Fable 5.2
output:
Tolu, I'm here o. Biology 100L, federal uni here in Lagos, and Medicine and Surgery is what I applied for. I scored 251 in JAMB 2025 and they offered me Biology, so I know that portal feeling very well.

The day I saw it, I locked myself in my cousin's room in Surulere and cried. I didn't eat that day. My mum was still telling people in church that I'm doing medicine for like two months after, and I had to beg her to stop. So you crying since afternoon is not you being dramatic. It pains, and it's allowed to pain you.

Let me answer what you asked.

**Can you actually transfer?**

Yes, it's real. Kingsley, no offence, but it's not a myth. favour, "just read hard" is too simple too. This is what our level adviser told us, and note that this is my own school:

1. You need a CGPA of at least 4.5 out of 5 after 100L.
2. There must be space in MBBS. If there's no space, your 4.5 is just a fine result.
3. You must have met the Medicine cut-offs in JAMB and post-UTME as well.

She said last year about 6 people got moved in from the whole faculty, and she thinks over 40 applied. That's the whole faculty, not only Biology. So people do move, but most of the people who try don't.

On number 3, I don't know your school's cut-offs or your post-UTME score, so I can't tell you if you qualify. 268 is a good score, but by itself it doesn't settle anything. Check your school's JAMB cut-off for Medicine and the post-UTME one, and check your own two scores against them. If you fall short on either one, the transfer talk may not apply to you at all, and it's better to know that now than after you've paid the acceptance fee.

As for me, my CGPA after first semester is 4.31. That's not 4.5. I'm still trying, but I'm telling you so you see that even somebody who entered with transfer in mind and is reading can be below the line. Please don't accept Biology thinking it's automatic. Your dad means well, but "accept and transfer after first year" is a hope, not a plan.

**How is it really?**

In 100L you'll do BIO 101, CHM 101, PHY 101, MTH 101 and GST. Physics and maths are the ones dealing with people. Many of us came in thinking "I'm a biology person" and then PHY 101 humbled us. If you're chasing 4.5, those two will decide it, not BIO.

There's money too. My lab coat was 6,500, the dissecting kit was 9k, and the practical manual is extra on top. Just so your people are not surprised.

**Is Biology bad?**

No, and I'm not saying that to console you. In our first BIO practical we dissected toads. One guy in my group fainted. I was fine, I was even enjoying it, and that day I realised I actually like this thing. I'm enjoying genetics and cell biology more than I expected. I came in seeing Biology as a waiting room for Medicine, and now I see it as a proper course that I happen to like.

That doesn't mean it will be the same for you. You asked if Biology is bad or if it's just that your mind was on Medicine. For me it was the second one. You'll have to find out your own.

**What about rewriting?**

Rewriting is not wrong if you're ready for it. But staying at home is not as easy as people make it sound. My secondary school classmate Ifeoma rejected a Pharmacy offer to rewrite for Medicine. She has written JAMB two more times since then and she's still at home. I'm not telling you this to scare you, and I'm not saying that will be you. With 268 you may be closer than she was. But "one year is nothing" is what people say when it's not their own year. If you choose it, know that it's not guaranteed either.

**What I'd do if I were you**

Before that acceptance deadline, go to the faculty or the department yourself and ask them the exact transfer rules for your own school: what CGPA, how many people they took last year, and whether your JAMB and post-UTME scores make you eligible. Don't just trust forum people, including me. What I've told you is what my adviser told us, and your school may do it differently.

Then ask yourself one question, and answer it when you're alone. Do you want Medicine, or do you want to be "doctor" for your parents? Those two are different. If it's the medicine itself, the patients and the work, then weigh transfer and rewriting seriously. If it's mostly the title and what people in church will say, you may find that Biology or something else fits you better than you think.

I can't tell you accept or rewrite, because I don't know your school's numbers and I don't know your heart. But I can tell you that the way you feel this week is not how you'll feel in three months. I really thought my life was over in that room in Surulere. It wasn't. Whichever one you choose, it's not the end of the world.

If you want to ask me anything about 100L, ask. I'll answer what I know.
